weapons.name: 爆能枪
weapons.summary: 发射蕴含纯粹能量的球体，命中后内爆，飞行距离越远，造成的伤害越高
weapons.summaryEn: Launch spheres of raw energy that implode on impact, dealing more damage the further they travel

weapons.name: 激光枪
weapons.summary: 想想激光笔，但是要致命一千倍
weapons.summaryEn: Think of a laser presentation pointer, but a thousand times deadlier

weapons.name: 等离子枪
weapons.summary: 虽然特斯拉是位工程天才，但真正让所有僵尸大脑化为灰烬的，是工程师的等离子枪
weapons.summaryEn: Tesla may have been a genius engineer, but it is the Engineer's Plasma that really makes all the zombie brains fry to ashes

weapons.name: 电击枪
weapons.summary: 经过改装的自卫工具，专门用来“治疗”僵尸之灾。近距离会造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Self-defence tool, tweaked to "cure" the undead bane. Bonus damage up close

weapons.name: 特斯拉枪
weapons.summary: 使用僵尸作为电源继电器，向有需要的地方输送电流
weapons.summaryEn: Supply electricity to the needy by using zombies as power relays

weapons.name: 弓
weapons.summary: 女猎手最青睐的武器。虽然传统，但在行家手中却非常致命
weapons.summaryEn: Huntress's preferred weapon. Classic yet deadly in good hands

weapons.name: 爆炸箭
weapons.summary: 你的弓会射出加装了感应炸弹的箭
weapons.summaryEn: Your bow shoots arrows equipped with proximity sensor bombs

weapons.name: 冰冻箭
weapons.summary: 女猎手在发射前会将箭矢浸入冷冻化学物质中
weapons.summaryEn: Huntress dips arrows in cryogenic chemicals before shooting

weapons.name: 多重发射
weapons.summary: 一次只射一支箭怎么够
weapons.summaryEn: In case firing one arrow at a time wasn't enough

weapons.name: 毒箭
weapons.summary: 女猎手在发射前会将箭矢浸入麻痹毒素中
weapons.summaryEn: Huntress dips arrows in paralysing poison before firing them

weapons.name: 链锯
weapons.summary: 撕碎一切。贴身距离会造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Rip and tear. Bonus damage at direct range

weapons.name: 骑兵枪
weapons.summary: 致命的发明，既能近距离手刃敌人，也能远距离射杀敌人
weapons.summaryEn: Deadly invention which either cuts enemies up close or shoots them down at a distance

weapons.name: 液氮枪
weapons.summary: 发射内部灌满了极速膨胀液氮的轻型榴弹
weapons.summaryEn: Fires a lightweight grenade filled to the brim with rapidly expanding liquid nitrogen

weapons.name: 扳手发射器
weapons.summary: 一种以扳手为弹药的武器，诠释了什么叫做疯狂
weapons.summaryEn: The definition of insanity in form of a weapon that uses spanners as ammunition

weapons.name: 可靠扳手
weapons.summary: 机械师的最佳搭档。既能近战，也能用作远程武器。命中时机械师与目标的距离越远，造成的伤害就越高
weapons.summaryEn: Mechanic's best friend. Works in close combat and as a long-range weapon. Bonus damage the further the Mechanic is when it hits

weapons.name: 解毒瓶
weapons.summary: 投掷一瓶解毒剂，彻底结束僵尸的痛苦。瓶子碎裂时距离越近，造成的额外伤害就越高
weapons.summaryEn: Throw a bottle of antidotal fluids to put an end to the zombie's suffering. Bonus damage the closer it shatters

weapons.name: 冰冻瓶
weapons.summary: 装满液氮的容器，能够帮助僵尸从痛苦中永久解脱。瓶子碎裂时距离越近，造成的额外伤害就越高
weapons.summaryEn: Ease their pain indefinitely with liquid nitrogen filled vessels. Bonus damage the closer it shatters

weapons.name: 自卫手枪
weapons.summary: 随身携带的小型武器，专门用于应对僵尸危机等突发状况
weapons.summaryEn: A small sidearm kept in case of emergencies such as zombie pandemics

weapons.name: 注射手枪
weapons.summary: 为那些未能及时接种疫苗的家伙注射疫苗。近距离注射会造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Vaccinate the ones that didn't get the vaccine in time. Bonus damage for direct injection

weapons.name: 注射步枪
weapons.summary: 你手头最顶级的工具，专治那些最棘手的患者
weapons.summaryEn: The best tool in your arsenal against the most troublesome patients in your care

weapons.name: 武士刀
weapons.summary: 致命的近战武器，配上更致命的武士
weapons.summaryEn: A deadly melee weapon in a hands of an even deadlier warrior

weapons.name: 武士刀横扫
weapons.summary: 正如大师所言：刀势越大，杀伤越广
weapons.summaryEn: In the words of the wise Sensei: A wide sword cuts wide

weapons.name: 夺魂
weapons.summary: 对单个敌人发动致命攻击，要么冻结其仍能活动的肉身，要么在其灵魂离开躯体时引发剧烈爆炸
weapons.summaryEn: Strike deadly on a single enemy, either freezing their still-living flesh or causing their soul to explode violently as it leaves their body

weapons.name: 千刃
weapons.summary: 遁入化境，出刀变幻莫测、快如闪电
weapons.summaryEn: Enter a state in which your cuts are unpredictable but blinding fast

weapons.name: 裂风
weapons.summary: 压缩周围空气，射出锐利风刃。飞行距离越远，造成的伤害就越高
weapons.summaryEn: Condense the surrounding air to launch razor sharp projectiles that deal higher damage the further it travels

weapons.name: 回旋斧
weapons.summary: 连续投掷燃烧手斧，手斧会在一段时间后飞回。飞行距离越远，对僵尸造成的切割和灼烧伤害越高
weapons.summaryEn: Throw one flaming hatchet after another, which will return after a while, slashing and burning zombies the further it travels

weapons.name: 喷灯
weapons.summary: 实用的小工具，既能熔化金属物体，也能在末日来临时熔化僵尸肉。近距离会造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: A fun little tool for melting metal objects and, in the event of an apocalypse, zombie flesh. Bonus damage at closer distances

weapons.name: 消防斧
weapons.summary: 挥舞沉重的消防斧，在周身圆形范围内造成高额近战伤害。用斧刃命中时会造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Swing a heavy firefighter's axe in a circular area around you, dealing heavy melee damage. Bonus damage when hitting with blade

weapons.name: 火焰喷射器
weapons.summary: 地狱级大规模杀伤性武器，是火焰兵的最佳搭档。中距离会造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: A weapon of infernal mass destruction, and Pyro's best friend to boot. Bonus damage at medium range

weapons.name: 地狱斧
weapons.summary: 蕴含地狱烈焰的强力近战武器。每次挥舞都能在巨大的圆形区域内杀伤敌人
weapons.summaryEn: A powerful melee weapon imbued with hellish flames that slashes enemies in a huge, circular area on every swing

weapons.name: 刺网弩
weapons.summary: 呈锥形发射两发弩箭，并在弩箭之间展开一道铁丝网。铁丝网会造成切割伤害并标记命中的目标，并且会在近距离造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Fires two bolts in a cone with barbed wire stretched between them. The wire slashes and marks hit targets and deals bonus damage at close range

weapons.name: 弩
weapons.summary: 游侠的首选武器。发射单发强力弩箭，对目标施加“标记”状态。动物攻击被标记的目标时，会在更大范围内造成额外伤害。
weapons.summaryEn: Ranger's preferred weapon. Fires single, powerful bolts that apply Marked status. Animal attacks on Marked targets deal bonus damage in larger area

weapons.name: 燃烧弩
weapons.summary: 点燃连弩的弩箭，进一步提升其效率。其射弹可穿透、标记并同时灼烧多个目标
weapons.summaryEn: Ignites the Repeater Crossbow bolts, increasing their efficiency even further. Its projectiles penetrate, mark, and can burn multiple targets at a time

weapons.name: 连弩
weapons.summary: 快速连续发射多支弩箭，并会自动切换目标。可标记更多目标，但在远距离时会损失部分潜在伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Rapidly fires multiple bolts in succession, switching targets when possible. Marks more targets but loses a bit of damage potential on long range

weapons.name: 电击弩
weapons.summary: 发射单发闪电弩箭，钉在敌人身上，引发放电并施加标记。远距离造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Fires single bolts of lightning that stick to enemies, causing electric discharges and marking their targets. Inflicts bonus damage at long range

weapons.name: 突击步枪
weapons.summary: 久经沙场的高效利器，助你在尸群中杀出一条血路
weapons.summaryEn: Plow through the horde with this proven and effective tool

weapons.name: 榴弹发射器
weapons.summary: 玩腻了小型弹药，于是你换上大型高爆弹药
weapons.summaryEn: Sometimes you get bored firing small projectiles, so you switch to large and exploding ones instead

weapons.name: 制式手枪
weapons.summary: 即使世界终结，它也会始终伴你左右。近距离射击伤害最高
weapons.summaryEn: He was always there for you, even when the world ended. Most effective at close range

weapons.name: 冲锋枪
weapons.summary: 抄起可靠的冲锋枪，向尸群疯狂扫射
weapons.summaryEn: Spray & pray the zombies with your trusty submachine gun

weapons.name: 狙击步枪
weapons.summary: 通过可穿透尸群的强力射击消灭关键目标。远距离会造成额外伤害
weapons.summaryEn: Eliminate key targets with powerful, horde-piercing shots. Bonus damage at long distance

weapons.name: 转轮机枪
weapons.summary: 对坦克来说算是迷你，对你的敌人来说可一点也不迷你。伤害会随距离衰减。
weapons.summaryEn: Mini by the Tank's standards, but not to your enemies. Damage falls off with distance.

weapons.name: 泵动式霰弹枪
weapons.summary: 发射强力鹿弹，直到枪管通红
weapons.summaryEn: Fire powerful buckshots as the barrel glows hot

weapons.name: 火箭发射器
weapons.summary: 把尸群轰上天，炸个粉碎
weapons.summaryEn: Send the horde to the moon, in pieces

weapons.name: 霰弹枪
weapons.summary: 有人说它慢，你却说这叫有条不紊。最适合中近距离作战
weapons.summaryEn: Some call it slow, you call it methodical. Best at close to medium range

weapons.name: 超级霰弹枪
weapons.summary: 如果射击范围内没有盲点，那么低精度就不是问题
weapons.summaryEn: Low accuracy is not an issue if no blind spots exist in your shooting area

hitEffectSources.particleRenderer: 各角色包中的 ParticleSystemRenderer（按 GameObject 名 <武器>_Hit_01 关联）
hitEffectSources.note: IL2CPP 构建剥离了 ParticleSystem 的 type tree，粒子颜色/尺寸/速度无法读回；预览里的播放节奏是按游戏特效惯例重建的，贴图、颜色与音效取自游戏原始数据。
